name: Suivi Receptions Olives
query: SELECT date_reception AS `Date:Date:100`, name AS `Réception:Link/Reception Olive:180`, fournisseur AS `Fournisseur:Link/Supplier:180`, poids_entree AS `Brut:Float:100`, tare_emballages AS `Tare:Float:100`, poids_payable AS `Payable Kg:Float:110`, montant_achat AS `Montant:Currency:130`, nouveau_solde AS `Solde:Currency:130` FROM `tabReception Olive` WHERE docstatus=1 ORDER BY date_reception DESC
